identity.title: List of English language Sinnoh League Victors home video releases (Region 4)

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of , Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of , Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
 
Two Sinnoh League Victors Collections were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in 2011, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 1 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on June 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on June 16, 2011. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined and uses a . Its catalogue number is 13734.

====Contents====
 
 
===Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 2 was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on October 5, 2011 and in New Zealand on October 19, 2011. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined and uses a . Its catalogue number is 13778.

====Contents====
 
 
==Season 13 disc set==
 
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010.

The Season 13 DigiPack disc set was released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on December 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on December 8, 2011. It contains four discs with 34 episodes across them combined and uses a . Its catalogue number is DBX13832. Its discs are designed to resemble a Quick Ball. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online on July 14, 2016 and in JB Hi-Fi stores on September 21, 2016 to celebrate the Pokémon 20th Anniversary. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.

This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5397.

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself. The featured Pokémon appears in at least one of the episodes on that disc, and is typically an important Pokémon in one of them.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Sinnoh League Victors episodes.
Pokémon Sinnoh Collection
Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection
Pokémon: Heritage Collection II
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
